profile.about: I am Pavan Londhe, a 2nd year Information Technology Engineering student at Tulshiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology, Nagpur. I am currently focused on Full Stack Development and continuously improving my programming and software development skills. I have learned HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, C and PHP. Along with web development, I am interested in AWS and Data Analysis. I enjoy creating practical websites and software projects while learning new technologies through hands-on development.
